s.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

Airbnb is seeking an exceptional product manager to reimagine how guests search on Airbnb. Search is the front door to the entire guest experience — the moment someone tells us what they want and we have to understand it, then show them the right options in the right order. Today that means query understanding, filtering, and ranking.

Tomorrow it means next-generation AI capabilities that let guests search more naturally, get better matches with less effort, and trust that Airbnb understood what they were actually looking for.
In this role, you will own the vision and roadmap for the future of search at Airbnb — pushing beyond keyword and filter-based search toward more intelligent, conversational, and personalized ways for guests to find their perfect stay. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and data science teams to bring new AI-powered search capabilities from concept to guests.
This is a high-visibility role building one of the most consequential surfaces in the guest experience, and will regularly interface with senior engineering and leadership stakeholders.

Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for the future of search on Airbnb, including next-generation AI capabilities like natural language and conversational search, query understanding, and intelligent ranking.
Own how guests search on Airbnb end to end — from the moment they express intent to the moment they find the right option.
Partner closely with engineering, applied ML, and data science teams to design, prototype, and ship AI-powered search experiences.
Use quantitative analysis and experimentation (A/B testing) to validate that new search capabilities improve relevance, conversion, and guest satisfaction.
Translate ambiguous guest problems into clear product requirements, prioritized against business impact and technical feasibility.
Collaborate with design and research to understand how guests search, filter, and decide today — and where AI can remove friction.
Work cross-functionally with Host-side and Trust teams to ensure smarter search continues to surface the right inventory fairly and accurately.
Communicate roadmap, results, and trade-offs clearly to engineering partners and leadership.

10+ years of consumer product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end.
Experience working on search, discovery, ranking, or recommendation systems is strongly preferred.
Genuine excitement about applying modern AI and ML capabilities (LLMs, semantic search, conversational interfaces) to consumer product problems.
Strong business acumen and ability to use data, research, and experimentation to drive product strategy and decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work closely with ML/data science teams and understand the trade-offs of model-driven products.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills across engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams.
A user-centered mindset — you dig into how guests actually search and where they get stuck, not just metrics dashboards.

Due to the nature of this position, there is a strong preference for the successful applicant will need to be based in San Francisco, CA to be able to conduct their work. Currently, employees can not be located in: Alaska, Indiana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Delaware And Rhode Island.

This list is continuously being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Who we are
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.
Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.
Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.
Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.
Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.
Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.
Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Balance new feature development with investment in quality, reliability, technical debt, and foundational platform capabilities across the app portfolio.
Improve how Stripe builds and operates strategic integrations by turning user, partner, and performance signals into scalable product and process improvements.

8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
TwoTwenty is Pinterest's incubation team. We invented Shuffles and Collages and we're the team behind Beauty Guides, Restyle and Smart Blocks. We're hiring a product manager to own one of our shipping products end to end, or to lead one of our next zero-to-one bets from a blank page to real users.

Own a product on TwoTwenty end to end, from strategy through post-launch iteration. You'll pick between a substantial slice of the teams AI Experiences charter or one of the team's next bets in areas like generative creation tools, live shopping or AI planning surfaces.
Make the product decisions that separate a demo from a product. You'll decide what ships in V1, defend the cut list and set the quality bar on your surface so designers and engineers calibrate to it.
Land launches that require alignment with partner teams inside Pinterest (AIFwd, Search, Shop with Pinterest, ATG). You'll get to agreement without needing your manager in the room.
Translate a company-level thesis into a concrete product decision your team can build against. You'll be able to state your product's strategy in one sentence and connect this week's engineering work to it.
Run experiments that answer real questions, not experiments that produce metrics. You'll decide when a null result is a launch signal and when a positive result isn't good enough.
Use AI to accelerate exploration, drafting and analysis in your day-to-day. This includes prototyping concepts, comparing design options and synthesizing user research, while applying judgment and verification to protect correctness and quality.
Mentor at least one PM or designer on the team on the craft of narrowing a problem before writing the doc.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience, including shipping a consumer product with an AI or ML component to at least one million users.
Experience owning a zero-to-one product from a blank page through real user traffic, not a prototype in a deck.
Experience saying no to a well-liked feature request from an executive and holding the line on quality.
Experience earning the trust of a senior engineering leader on architectural decisions, and can describe how you did it.
Understanding of the difference between a strategy and a plan, and the ability to state your current team's strategy in one sentence.
Experience using AI to accelerate product exploration, competitive analysis or user research synthesis, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality before decisions get made.
Committed to owning outcomes end to end. You treat things outside your scope as yours when the product needs it, and you don't lean on process to make decisions the team is looking to you for.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science, design, human-computer interaction or business, or equivalent experience.

The Programmatic Ads team at Pinterest builds the foundation for scalable and automated advertising through integrations with top demand-side platforms (DSPs), supply-side platforms (SSPs), and other partners. We design and deliver programmatic solutions that respect the user’s discovery experience while maximizing value for advertisers. As digital advertising rapidly evolves, we’re on a mission to set Pinterest apart through powerful, transparent, and measurable programmatic ad offerings.
We are seeking an experienced product leader to drive the next phase of growth in programmatic advertising at Pinterest.
As Staff Product Manager, Programmatic Ads, you will define, build, and scale our suite of programmatic advertising products and integrations. You’ll play a pivotal role in driving the product vision, roadmap, and cross-functional execution to enable advertisers and partners to seamlessly transact across Pinterest’s rapidly growing ad marketplace.

Collaborate with product leadership to help define and execute the roadmap for Pinterest’s programmatic ad offerings, ensuring alignment with business goals and advertiser needs.
Work closely with engineering, sales, partnerships, ad operations, data science, and design to build products that drive adoption, performance, and satisfaction among advertisers.
Prioritize product initiatives, balancing immediate customer needs with longer-term scalability and automation opportunities.
Develop a strong understanding of the programmatic ad ecosystem (including DSPs, SSPs, auction mechanics, and deal types) to inform product decisions and ensure competitive differentiation.
Deliver features and tools that provide actionable insights, streamlined workflows, and effective reporting for programmatic buyers and Pinterest’s internal teams.
Leverage data and user feedback to inform product prioritization, track success metrics, and recommend enhancements
Partner with designers to create intuitive interfaces, dashboards, and reporting tools for programmatic workflows.
Serve as a key resource on programmatic ad products within the team and across partner functions.

5+ years of Product Management experience, with a demonstrated record of launching and improving advertising or ad tech products, ideally in programmatic or related spaces.
Experience building products that use data and insights to support business users and drive measurable growth.
Practical knowledge of programmatic ad technology (bid requests/responses, auction mechanics, deal types such as PMP, PG, Open Auction).
Familiarity with building workflow or reporting tools for advertisers, agencies or internal operations teams.
Experience partnering with DSPs, SSPs, agencies, or other third-party ad platforms.
Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with a data-driven approach to delivering business impact.
Comfort working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit is seeking a Staff Product Manager to spearhead the product strategy for Ads Trust & Safety. In this role, you will architect and scale the next generation of systems across ad review, advertiser trust, fraud prevention, and platform safeguards.

Your mission: protect our global community of users and brands while unlocking the safe, hyper-growth trajectory of Reddit’s ads business.You will collaborate with cross-functional partners to engineer products and processes that maximize advertiser success without ever compromising on safety, quality, or compliance.

This is a definitive opportunity for a visionary product leader who thrives in ambiguity, commands thoughtful trade-offs, and excels at translating complex integrity challenges into a crystal-clear product direction.
The Ads Trust & Safety team is the frontline guardian of Reddit's advertising ecosystem, ensuring it remains resilient, trusted, and secure as our business scales. Operating at the high-impact intersection of advertising, safety, automation, and operational excellence, the team handles everything from ad review and fraud prevention to policy enforcement and platform integrity.
We partner closely with Engineering, Policy, Legal, Sales, Operations, Product Marketing, and the Reddit Consumer teams to build agile systems that adapt instantly to shifting advertiser needs, emerging abuse vectors, and evolving global regulations.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of building and scaling products in ads trust and safety, fraud prevention, risk systems, or compliance workflows. You should possess exceptional product judgment, a systems-thinking mindset, and the leadership gravity to unite both technical and non-technical teams.
Drive the Vision: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Ads Integrity, encompassing ad review, fraud prevention, advertiser trust, and platform quality.
Balance the Ecosystem: Masterfully balance advertiser experience, user safety, operational efficiency, business impact, and complex regulatory landscapes in every product decision.
Unite Cross-Functional Partners: Lead alignment and deliver durable, long-term solutions alongside Engineering, Policy, Legal, Operations, Sales, Product Marketing, and broader product organizations.
Translate Insights into Action: Convert advertiser pain points, integrity risks, and operational bottlenecks into sharp product requirements, robust success metrics, and measurable business outcomes.
Innovate & Automate: Identify high-leverage opportunities to enhance automation, elevate decision quality, optimize feedback loops, and drive enforcement consistency across both ambiguous 0-to-1 initiatives and mature scaling systems.

6+ years of product management experience, with a proven history of owning complex, highly cross-functional product domains.
Domain Expertise: Deep experience building products in digital advertising, advertiser workflows, ad policy, trust and safety, fraud prevention, abuse detection, risk-based decisioning, or platform integrity.
Advanced Systems Thinking: The ability to reason holistically across user experience, policy frameworks, operational workflows, data pipelines, and technical architecture.
Intelligent Automation: Hands-on experience building products that seamlessly blend automation, human review, feedback loops, machine learning, or AI-assisted workflows.
Ambiguity to Execution: A demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous product spaces from zero to strategy, through execution, utilizing data and metrics to ruthlessly prioritize and guide trade-offs.
Influence & Communication: Elite cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence without authority and distill highly complex topics into clear, actionable narratives.
100% remote opportunity (we have 4 office locations for hybrid/onsite work preference in NY, SF, LA and Chicago)

Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) & workplace perks (home office set up stipend etc)
Generous 401k matching
Flexible vacation policy

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Build enterprise-grade AI agents : As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.
Engage with customers : In the role, you will engage with all levels of our customers’ businesses:

Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.
Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.
Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.
Become trusted advisors and drive strategic technical strategies for our customers.
Shape the product roadmap : Work with Sierra’s engineering and product development teams to scope and implement new features essential to the success of your customers.

3-5+ years experience in product development of highly technical products.
Past experience in Product Management or other similar product development roles at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.
Experience crafting and tailoring a message for potential customers, including executives.
Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent AI developments.
Professional fluency in both Spanish and English.
Degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Even better...
AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).
Some coding experience with React, Typescript, and Go.
MBA or equivalent professional experience (while this is a product management role, you will have the opportunity to lean into broader business roles).
Past roles that interface with end customers to influence software development.

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

Sprint & Execution Ownership
Run the product/engineering sprint cadence — standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retros
Keep releases on track and unblock engineering as issues arise
Translate roadmap priorities into clear, well-scoped tickets and specs
Roadmap & Ideation

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build relationships with HER's Head of Product and founder to stay aligned with brand vision
Data-Informed Decision-Making
Use product analytics to inform prioritization and measure the impact of shipped work
Design and interpret experiments in partnership with Data/Analytics

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
As the Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how every team builds Vanta's interface.

Your mission is to build the horizontal tooling that lets product, engineering, and design teams create consistent, high-quality user experiences faster, so they can spend more of their time on their customers.

To be successful, you’ll need to have a high level of product taste and be able to set and hold the line for high quality and easy to use products. All while working closely with your engineering and design manager partners.
You'll be part of Vanta's Platform organization, which builds the foundational primitives and craft layer the rest of the product is built on. This is the first dedicated Design Systems PM role at Vanta, so you'll help shape the function itself, not just the roadmap. It's a high-autonomy, highly cross-functional role at the center of how Vanta looks, feels, and scales.
What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta:
Own the vision and roadmap for the frontend, spanning the design system and the front-end platform, and ladder durable platform investments to company initiatives so design and engineering can focus on customers.
Evolve our design system from a broad component library into smaller, composable building blocks with consistent APIs, including making components first-class for AI and LLM-driven experiences.
Drive accessibility and internationalization programs to their committed milestones, including global-scale localization and meeting accessibility standards.
Partner with our AI team to enable the agentic patterns product teams need to build the next generation of Vanta experiences.
Run go-to-market and adoption for design-system changes, and lead ongoing quality and "paper cuts" triage as the craft team for the entire product.
Partner closely with your engineering and design leads as a triad, continuously prioritizing the highest-impact work across a wide surface area.
Look 12 to 18 months ahead at how the design system and front-end platform scale with Vanta, including AI-native use.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
Have 4-8+ years of product management experience, with real ownership of a design system, frontend platform, or developer and design experience that served many teams.
Bring craft and taste at scale. You have a clear point of view on quality, you can scale it across many teams, and you earn craft credibility with senior design and product leaders.
Have a builder's mindset. You're not an engineer, but you're hands-on: you spin up prototypes and demos and build with the same component building blocks that your team ships.
Collaborate horizontally and build trust. You serve every product team as an internal platform, build consensus across the company, and you're the partner other teams are glad to see at their door.
Think in systems. You reason about how components, tokens, patterns, and front-end infrastructure fit together and cascade across every product surface.
Tell the story. You translate why front-end and design-system investment matters into clear business value for leadership and cross-functional partners.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Serving public sector customers is an integral part of ServiceNow 's business and future growth trajectory. ServiceNow is a leading provider of digital workflows for many federal, state, and local government agencies in the United States.

To help these organizations successfully fulfill their missions and deliver better experiences to citizens and constituents, ServiceNow provides specialized cloud environments that meet and exceed the data and security regulations and policies of our government customers.

These environments span ServiceNow -hosted regulated clouds, customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, and emerging sovereign offerings.

ServiceNow is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own strategy and execution across our U.S. Public Sector cloud platforms — a portfolio that includes our regulated ServiceNow -hosted environments (e.g., GCC and NSC), our self-hosted and partner-operated Private Stack deployments.
In this senior individual-contributor role you will define how the ServiceNow platform operates across isolated, customer-managed, and partner-hosted environments, setting cross-domain strategy and driving parity with our commercial cloud while meeting stringent compliance, security, and sovereignty requirements.

You will shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, own multi-quarter strategy and roadmap, and directly influence the roadmap of the broader ServiceNow Platform to better serve this specialized segment of customers.
You will operate at the intersection of platform architecture, compliance, and go-to-market, leading multi-team and multi-VP programs and aligning engineering, security, GTM, legal, and partner ecosystems. Reporting into the Regulated Markets & Public Sector product organization, you will be a key member of a team that drives the growth of ServiceNow 's public sector business.
Your product portfolio
Regulated ServiceNow -hosted clouds — Own strategy and roadmap for offerings (e.g., GCC, NSC) supporting U.S. federal, state, local, and other regulated public sector customers, aligned to frameworks such as FedRAMP, DoD IL4/IL5, CJIS, and FIPS.
Self-hosted / Private Stack (incl. Private Stack Pro) — Own strategy for customer-managed and partner-operated deployments, driving the containerized, scalable Private Stack Pro deployment model and the official Private Stack go-to-market.
Pro & sovereign offerings — Own roadmap, packaging, and GTM strategy for Pro hosted deployments and emerging sovereign asks, including new-market entry evaluation.
Partner & ecosystem model — Define how partners deliver ServiceNow as a regulated and sovereign platform, setting operating models, certification approaches, and GTM strategy.
What you get to do in this role
Own cross-domain product strategy and a multi-quarter roadmap across the U.S. public sector cloud portfolio, balancing parity, compliance-driven capabilities, and platform scalability across offerings.
Shape the market point of view for regulated public sector, anticipating parity blockers and validating federal, DoD, and SLED nuances (e.g., ATO, boundary, connectivity).
Define scalable compliance and security patterns (e.g., pre-authorization guardrails) with legal, compliance, OCISO, and security teams, anticipating NIST/TLS/CMMC deltas and de-risking early.
Partner with engineering to set architecture direction across deployment models ( ServiceNow -hosted, customer-managed, partner-hosted, disconnected/air-gapped), containerization, and security, identity, and connectivity approaches.

Lead multi-team and multi-VP programs, influencing OCISO, legal, and infrastructure leadership to unblock delivery and align on strategy.
Design GTM motions with Legal and enable the field — positioning, FAQs, RFP responses, architecture guidance, and playbooks — to reduce sales friction across Private Stack, Pro, and sovereign offerings.
Own data-driven prioritization: balance capacity, cost, and revenue with scenario planning; tie investment to NNACV; and drive business cases and New Market Entry analysis tied to TAM and CACV.
Standardize specification and communication templates across the organization and set the documentation bar for regulated offerings; monitor competitive intelligence as an input into product strategy.

At ServiceNow, we're transforming how organizations manage and optimize supply chain operations through intelligent workflows, automation, and AI.

The Supply Chain Operations team is building innovative solutions that help customers gain visibility across complex supply networks, proactively identify disruptions, and rapidly resolve exceptions that impact business performance.

Our products enable supply chain, procurement, logistics, and operations teams to detect issues earlier, prioritize actions intelligently, collaborate across stakeholders, and automate remediation at scale.
As part of this fast-growing business, you'll help define the future of Supply Chain Exception Management, partnering closely with engineering, data science, customers, and ecosystem partners to build enterprise-grade solutions that improve resilience, reduce operational risk, and keep global supply chains running smoothly.

From integrating with leading ERP, transportation, and warehouse management systems to leveraging AI for predictive insights and automated decision-making, our team is reimagining how modern supply chains operate in an increasingly dynamic world.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:

Be a true technical partner — diving deep into architecture decisions, system design, and implementation tradeoffs to deliver scalable, performant solutions.
Contribute to Product Strategy: Design and deliver product features for a fast-growing supply chain operations business unit, with initial focus on supply chain exception management. Collaborate closely with engineering to execute on strategies that deliver value to our supply chain and procurement customers.
Build the Partner Ecosystem: Work closely with supply chain technology partners, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), transportation management systems (TMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), and ERP vendors to co-develop integrated solutions. Partner with engineering to ensure our platform APIs and integrations enable seamless partner ecosystem expansion.
Collaborate with Customers: Build relationships with supply chain leaders, procurement teams, logistics operators, and supply chain exception management practitioners through design programs and product advisory councils. Demo and present supply chain capabilities to existing and prospective customers. Champion the customer to the rest of the product management, sales, and marketing organization to influence supply chain product strategy.
Drive Cross Company Outcomes: Work cross functionally with other product teams and partners to deliver joint product features that deliver value to customers across procurement, logistics, inventory management, demand planning, and exception management. Enable seamless integration between supply chain operations and broader enterprise functions (finance, manufacturing, customer success).
Win as a Team: Collaborate with a team of dedicated and engaged product managers and engineers with a collective goal of serving supply chain and operations customers at enterprise scale — while building strong partnership relationships that extend our platform capabilities.

s.h: To be successful in this role you have
s.t:
Deep supply chain domain expertise: 12+ years of product management experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, demand planning, or inventory optimization — ideally at enterprise software companies or managing complex, multi-stakeholder operations products.
Supply chain exception management expertise: Demonstrated understanding of exception management workflows, alert prioritization, root cause analysis, and remediation processes in supply chain operations. Experience building products or features that help teams identify, triage, and resolve supply chain disruptions (demand-supply mismatches, supplier delays, inventory exceptions, logistics exceptions).
Strong technical acumen: Previous experience as a software engineer or deep familiarity with software architecture, APIs, databases, and system design. Comfortable diving into technical discussions with engineering about scalability, performance, data modeling, and infrastructure tradeoffs specific to supply chain exception management systems.
Partner ecosystem experience: Proven success building products in partner-centric ecosystems or platforms. Experience collaborating with technology partners, system integrators, or ISVs to co-develop solutions. Understanding of how to design APIs and integrations that enable partners to extend platform capabilities.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into supply chain processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include AI-powered exception detection, intelligent alert prioritization, predictive exception prevention, automated remediation workflows, or AI-driven supply chain visibility.
Demonstrated leadership experience and strategic thinking operating at the scale of large enterprise supply chain software products — with proven ability to manage complex product portfolios serving procurement, logistics, operations, and exception management teams.
Fluency in supply chain operations: Understanding of end-to-end supply chain functions including demand planning, procurement workflows, inventory management, supplier relationship management, logistics optimization, exception management, and supply chain risk management.
Comfortable with pivoting, learning fast, and communicating with impact — especially when translating between supply chain domain complexity and technical architecture with both engineers and business audiences.
Be comfortable presenting to and communicating with diverse stakeholders — from frontline exception management teams to C-suite supply chain leaders, engineering teams, and partner stakeholders. Strong ability to translate between technical capabilities and business outcomes (OTIF, forecast accuracy, inventory turns, exception resolution time, cost reduction).
Strong prioritization skills and the discipline to focus on high-impact activities that drive measurable supply chain outcomes and business value — while balancing direct customer needs, engineering velocity, and partner ecosystem expansion.
Experience gathering and capturing product requirements from supply chain stakeholders and partners, working with engineering to translate them into technical specifications and architecture decisions that inform a product roadmap balancing operational needs, partner capabilities, and strategic transformation goals.
Deep curiosity about supply chain customer needs and a track record in building customer relationships, partner relationships, and delivering customer-centric and partner-friendly solutions that solve real supply chain challenges — in close partnership with engineering teams.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the Product - Connect Platform
Connect is Stripe’s platform for businesses that serve other businesses. It gives platforms the infrastructure to represent the people and companies in their ecosystem, onboard and verify them, manage their accounts, accept payments, and pay them out - without building payments, compliance, or financial-services systems themselves.

This is how businesses like Shopify can help entrepreneurs run and grow their businesses. It is also the kind of infrastructure that marketplaces such as DoorDash need to coordinate money movement across large networks of restaurants, merchants, and dashers.
Connect has impact across industries. Shopify uses Stripe to embed financial services for merchants; Lugg streamlines worker onboarding and offers instant payouts; DoorLoop reduces manual customer onboarding tasks by nearly 50% with Stripe; and Sharetribe helps entrepreneurs launch and run marketplaces on Stripe.
AI is accelerating the emergence of entirely new business models: global networks of creators and experts, AI-native marketplaces, and agent-driven products that change how people discover, buy, sell, and deliver services. These businesses are more dynamic than traditional platforms: participants may operate across borders, take on different roles, and need new ways to establish trust, access financial capabilities, and get paid.
The Connect Abstractions team owns the platform primitives that make these models possible. We are building the foundational abstractions for representing participants, onboarding them safely, configuring their capabilities, and managing their lifecycle on Stripe. Our work will determine how quickly the next generation of platforms can launch, how flexibly they can evolve, and how much of Stripe they can bring to the businesses and people they serve.
Why this role
This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies.
The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users?
The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product Manager to build the platform experiences behind Connect's next generation of users. You will own critical product primitives that platforms, including the fastest-growing AI companies, use to onboard, configure, and manage their users on Stripe. You will turn a clear strategic direction into products that solve hard user problems today while creating a coherent, extensible foundation for business models that are still being invented.
This role is for someone who enjoys the depth of platform work but is uncompromising about product craft and solving real user needs - both the ones users have today and will have in the future. The work is not building infra for its own sake; you will build capabilities that help our users launch a new marketplace, enable a global network to pay its contributors, or give a business entirely new ways for their end users to earn.

Bring the next generation of Connect accounts to life. Own key product areas within the account platform, translating strategy into a focused roadmap, crisp product decisions, and high-quality launches.
Build from use cases. Start with the real problems platforms face, such as onboarding a new seller, supporting a complex business model, or evolving a user's financial capabilities, and then work towards the primitives needed to solve them well.
Make sophisticated infrastructure feel simple. Partner with engineering and design to create API and product experiences that are powerful and intuitive.
See around corners. Develop a strong point of view on how AI will change platform economics, participant models, and financial workflows. Make focused foundational investments that unlock the next wave of demand.
Turn user signals into durable product investments. Work closely with users, Sales, Partnerships, and other Stripe teams to distinguish bespoke requests from patterns that should become scalable platform capabilities, connecting business needs, user needs, and platform evolution.
Drive high-velocity, high-craft execution and own outcomes. Lead cross-functional work from discovery through launch, and hold yourself accountable for developer experience, platform adoption, user value, and business impact, not simply features shipped.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
You are a product builder who can move easily between a user’s hardest problem, the business opportunity behind it, and the product decisions needed to solve it.
You have worked on technically complex products - such as APIs, developer tools, shared platform capabilities, or core product experiences - but you do not build tech/platform for its own sake. You see strong platform design as a way to help users move faster, create better products, and unlock new business models.
You are opinionated, thoughtful, and execution-oriented. You can focus a team on the few decisions that matter most, create momentum in ambiguous situations, and ship products that raise the bar for both quality and impact.

What to Expect from the Hiring Process We believe hiring should feel like a conversation, not a test. Here’s what you can expect if you apply: Step 1 — Conversation with People & Culture (30 minutes) If your experience looks like a fit, you’ll meet with our Head of People & Culture for a video chat.

It’s a two-way conversation, we’ll learn about your background, skills, and what energizes you, and you’ll have space to ask about Revaly , our mission, and what it’s like to work here. It’s also a chance to make sure the vibes are right on both sides.

Step 2 — Conversation with the Hiring Manager (60 minutes) Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a deeper dive into your role-specific experience. We’ll talk through real scenarios, how you approach challenges, and what success looks like in this role. You’ll also get a clearer picture of the team’s goals and priorities.

Step 3 — Meet a Future Teammate (60 minutes) In this stage, you’ll meet with someone from the team you’ll work closely with. This is your chance to get an on-the-ground perspective, how the team collaborates, what day-to-day looks like, and the kind of people you’ll be building alongside.

Step 4 — 90 Day Ramp Up Presentation (30 minutes) In this final stage, we ask candidates to prepare and present a 90 day ramp up plan to the hiring manager. This is an opportunity for candidates to outline how they would approach their first 3 months in the role, what they’d aim to learn, prioritize, and accomplish.

This is a chance to show your understanding of the role, the company, and the environment we’re operating in, while giving the hiring manager a glimpse into how you think, structure your approach to learning and communicate your ideas.

We hire for both skill and fit, looking for people who are not just aligned with our values, but who will add to our culture with their ideas, energy, and perspective.

If you’ve applied for a role in Technology or Product Development, you can also expect a skill-based assessment between step 3 and 4, to help us assess some key role-based requirements.

Revaly is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities.

Match Group AI Team Introduction
Match Group AI (MG AI) is the central tech organization that drives innovation across Match Group's global portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Azar, Pairs, Match, BLK, etc. Match Group aims to spark meaningful connections for everyone, worldwide, and the MG AI team's role is to bring cutting-edge AI to unblock the challenges along that journey, across diverse domains (e.g., Recommendation, Trust & Safety, Profile Enhancement).
Unlike brand-specific teams (e.g., Tinder, HYPERCONNECT AI), MG AI team offers the unique opportunity to impact the entire Match Group ecosystem. You won't just build for one app; we aim to develop scalable AI solutions that power Tinder, Hinge, and beyond, defining the technological gold standard for the global dating industry.
Detailed article: Introduction to Match Group AI Team (written in Korean)

Working as a Product Manager at MG AI
While engineers focus on building and shipping models, Product Managers at MG AI own the why and the what. We translate complex, often ambiguous business challenges from Match Group's brands into clear ML product strategy, and we drive execution across a globally distributed team. The PMs who thrive here are strategic troubleshooters with a bias for action: they spot what is blocking progress and drive it to resolution instead of waiting.
This is a communication-first role, but that does not mean coordination alone. Your core job is to figure out which problem is worth solving, articulate it in clear and precise language, and drive alignment among a diverse set of stakeholders across cultures and time zones. You own the product thinking end to end: framing the problem, shaping the plan, and defining what we build.
You will work on projects that leverage a wide range of technologies, from on-device ML modules to server-side AI models and LLMs. You do not need to be an ML expert on day one, but you must learn fast and become technically fluent enough to make sound product calls, because the technology and the problems keep changing.

Frame the Problem: Figure out which problems are worth solving and why, and articulate them in clear, precise language that a diverse team can rally around.
Shape the Roadmap: Decide what matters most, sequence the work, make the tradeoffs, and write PRDs, keeping partners aligned as priorities shift.
Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Act as the connective tissue between Match Group's brands, and the many functions within them, and MG AI engineering. Read the unspoken dynamics, build alignment across brands, functions, cultures, and time zones, and keep everyone moving in the same direction.
Hands-on Execution: Stay deeply involved in the details. Use experiments, behavioral data, and research to guide your calls when signals are imperfect, unblock engineering, and make the small decisions that keep a project moving.

Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Management (most important): You excel at managing stakeholders in complex, high-ambiguity situations. You read between the lines, sense interpersonal and organizational dynamics, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities. This is the single most important quality for this role.
4-6 years of product management experience in the Tech domain, ideally on complex systems or data or ML-driven products.
Fast Learning Curve & Strong Will to Learn: You do not need to be ML-savvy today, but you must ramp quickly and become technically fluent enough to shape direction on model behavior and tradeoffs without needing to be deeply technical.
Fluent in English (Able to conduct business meetings and participate in complex discussions without requiring assistance.)
Fluent in Korean (Sophisticated professional interactions with native-level precision and an understanding of cultural nuances.) Essential for cross-functional collaboration within the Seoul office.
Strong Ownership & Bias for Action: A track record of driving problems to resolution without waiting for permission. You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and making principled calls when the signals are imperfect.
Analytical Rigor: Comfort with data. You can define metrics, design and read experiments, and let evidence guide your decisions.
Global Operational Readiness: Ability to accommodate flexible working hours for regular early morning syncs with US teams (EST/PST).

A Point of View on AI Tooling: A clear sense of how AI tools can raise the quality and speed of product work, and a habit of using them (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
ML Product Experience: Exposure to ML-driven products (Recommendation, Search, Ranking, or Trust & Safety) and a working understanding of the ML lifecycle, from data to online A/B testing.
Matching Products Experience: Experience with products that match people or content (e.g., dating, marketplaces, social feeds, or hiring).
Internal Platform / B2B2C Experience: Success in a role where your primary customers were other internal business units or engineering teams.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Experience working with diverse, globally distributed teams and organizations.

We work in a domain-based model, where each product team owns a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration within cross-functional teams and ensures that the expertise for continuous product discovery, hypothesis development, and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.
As a Senior Product Manager, you drive and execute the strategy, set a clear direction, and make sure your domain delivers meaningful value to both customer groups, homeowners and partners, as well as to the business.
You continuously shape domain strategy and vision, setting clear measurable goals and a roadmap for homeowner acquisition: steering the full acquisition mix across paid and unpaid channels with a clear focus on growing the organic share, improving conversion along the homeowner journey, and raising the quality of the service requests handed to matching. You grow sustainable, unpaid acquisition through SEO, AI search optimization and scalable acquisition systems that compound over time, while keeping paid channels an effective and efficient part of the mix. You design and read high-traffic conversion experiments to lift conversion and data quality.
You are responsible for building a robust architecture and foundation that supports our acquisition experience. You ensure our setup is scalable and ready for automated qualification, enabling seamless processes that benefit the entire marketplace.
You identify where AI genuinely improves the homeowner experience and the platform's qualification processes, and you bring those opportunities into production together with Engineering, from first prompt experiments to shipped, measurable features.
You drive domain growth through continuous end-to-end product discovery, using qualitative insights (interviews, usability tests, feedback, NPS) and quantitative data to identify opportunities and make evidence-based, outcome-driven decisions with measurable impact.
You communicate with clarity and purpose, translate complex system and data topics into compelling narratives, and foster strong collaboration across Product, Tech, Product Analytics, UX, SEO and Content, Sales, and cross-domain stakeholders. You help carry the shift from a sales-driven organization toward a product platform.
You ensure a strong balance between long-term strategic goals and short-term trade-offs, driving continuous lean delivery through effective backlog management and close collaboration with Engineering and Design.

You have hands-on experience building organic acquisition and understand SEO fundamentals (topical authority, local SEO, structured data, page performance) as well as how AI-driven search and assistants are changing discovery (AEO), ideally within a marketplace or high-volume consumer platform.

At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.
Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers.

Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.
Our platform is trusted by over 6 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $257M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.
We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.
Applying to Render
We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's datastores portfolio, with our Postgres offering at the center. You will define what a modern managed database experience looks like, including how database products will adapt to new state patterns from agents and how agents as users of state-keeping products should be accommodated.
You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render Postgres and our broader data layer, working directly with your team and infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You'll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their data needs and build conviction about where the datastores portfolio needs to go next.

Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Render's datastores, anchored on Postgres. Your scope spans provisioning and lifecycle management, high availability and disaster recovery, backups and point-in-time recovery, scaling and performance, connection management, and the extension ecosystem.
Drive prioritization across Render's data investments, balancing the leverage of foundational reliability work — replication, failover, storage performance — against near-term product and business needs, and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs.
Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's data layer, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for durability, performance, and operational simplicity. Databases are where customer trust is won or lost, so an instinct for reliability and data safety is essential.
Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how managed Postgres needs to evolve to serve AI-native builders — from vector workloads and retrieval pipelines to databases that are spun up, branched, and torn down programmatically by agents at scale.
Set the standard for how developers experience data on Render, providing clear guidance, sensible defaults, and abstractions that make it easy for teams to run production databases with confidence — without needing a DBA on staff.

7+ years in Product Management, with the majority spent on databases, data infrastructure, developer tools, or platform products.
Familiarity with Postgres — its architecture, operational model, ecosystem, and the tradeoffs teams face running it in production. Bonus if you have strong perspective on how agentic workloads and AI-native applications are reshaping database usage patterns.
Deep developer empathy, for both internal engineering teams and our customers, and the technical depth to make sound architectural tradeoffs in collaboration with engineering.
A track record of taking ambiguous, high-stakes reliability and infrastructure problems and turning them into clear strategy and shipped outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling skills.

Your mission: enable customers and internal teams to answer critical workforce, payroll, finance, and compliance questions with confidence through trusted, well-designed reporting and insights experiences.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Sales, Customer Success, Security, Legal, and Operations, you will bring the customer judgment, technical depth, and product craft needed to build reporting that is accurate, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI-assisted workflows and insights.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with cross-functional partners to ensure every reporting and insights capability succeeds commercially, technically, and operationally.

Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on reporting, analytics, data platforms, workflow, or insights products .
Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand data schemas, query patterns, analytics code, and AI-assisted workflows hands-on.
Data Understanding & Fluency (Required): Strong end-to-end data literacy across models/schemas, lineage, and report generation. Comfortable with grain/joins/aggregations and common pitfalls (double-counting, currency/timezones, effective dating, late-arriving data).
Able to read/write SQL to validate results, investigate discrepancies, and ensure metrics are well-defined, reconciled, and trustworthy. Partner effectively with Data/Engineering to resolve definition and modeling issues.
Customer Focus: Deep empathy for customers and a strong sense of what matters most in their day-to-day workflows.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.
Strong UX Sensibilities: A passion for effortless experiences. You believe that complex data, reporting, and insights workflows should feel simple, trustworthy, and useful to the end user.
Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can explain complex data, reporting, AI, and compliance trade-offs to non-technical executives and clearly articulate value to customers and internal stakeholders.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.
Domain Expertise (nice to have): Experience with HR Tech, payroll, finance, compliance, or B2B SaaS products. You understand data models, reporting needs, compliance constraints, and common workflow pain points in this space.

Set the reporting and insights strategy: Define the vision and roadmap for a multi-surface reporting system across in-app report building, dashboards, scheduled delivery, exports, APIs/connectors, embedded partner surfaces, and AI/agent experiences.
Deeply understand customer reporting needs: Build empathy for payroll, finance, HR, executive, manager, internal operator, and partner/builder personas — translating different workflows, trust thresholds, and AI readiness levels into clear product priorities.
Build trusted reporting foundations: Own payroll-grade reporting capabilities including standard reports, configurable report building, GL/journal exports, variance reporting, reconciliation, definitions, permissions, lineage, auditability, and observability.
Develop intelligent insights experiences: Identify where AI, anomaly detection, driver analysis, and proactive recommendations can help users understand what changed and what to do next — while keeping outputs explainable, source-backed, and compliant.
Deliver through strong cross-functional execution: Partner with Data, Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Sales, CX, Finance, Operations, and partners to turn customer needs into technically sound, scalable reporting solutions.
Measure and improve impact: Establish KPIs for adoption, engagement, trust, report accuracy, distribution usage, retention, expansion, and internal leverage; continuously use feedback and data to improve the product.

This role owns the systems and strategies that protect Remote and its customers — from onboarding verification and screening, to credit risk assessment and reserve management, to fraud detection and enforcement across the full customer lifecycle.
You'll drive the evolution of our risk and compliance capabilities from reactive, rule-based controls toward proactive, automated systems that identify risk signals early and scale without proportional increases in manual effort. Seasoned Product Manager, with a track record on platform, API, or products for operational teams.
Platform mindset. You build systems others can extend. Scalability means growing the business without proportional increases in manual work or complexity.
Strong UX sensibilities . Risk and compliance tooling doesn't have to be painful. You care about the admin experience as much as the customer-facing one.
Outstanding communication and collaboration skills. You partner effectively with compliance, engineering, design, treasury, and legal — and you lead by example on async workflows.
Data-driven decision-making. Comfortable querying data and working with visualisation tools, you let insights drive your prioritisation.
Fast learner with a growth mindset. You're humble, eager to learn, and get up to speed quickly in new territory, then pass on what you pick up so the whole team levels up.
Great judgment - making strategic (what to prioritize) and tactical (feature scope) decisions.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on the rails Luno has spent over a decade building. Measure time-to-onboard and abandonment: find where institutions drop out, discover why, and design the changes that fix it
Own the relationship with verification vendors: integration, performance, cost and our roadmap
Extend the platform to multi-region and global onboarding: working with legal, risk and country teams to turn a regulatory position into a compliant product

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to help build our Occupational Health bet inside New Ventures based in Brazil . This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.
Occupational health is one of the largest, most regulated, and most stubbornly analog corners of corporate wellbeing.

In Brazil alone, it is a multi-billion real market: every company is legally required to run occupational exams, manage regulatory compliance (NR-01 and the new psychosocial-risk mandate, eSocial reporting), and look after the health of its workforce.

Yet the industry still runs on paper, manual scheduling, fragmented clinics, and reports nobody reads. We intend to rebuild it, at AI speed.
You will partner directly with the Founder/GM of the Occupational Health bet as the product lead of a small, single-threaded squad. This is a 0-to-1 build: the thesis is set, the market is chosen, but the product, the workflow, and the operating model are still being invented.

You report to the VP Product, New Ventures, and you'll work daily with the Founder/GM, design and engineering craft leads, and a fleet of AI agents to take this bet from earliest hypothesis through validation, MVP, first paying customers, and scale.

Own product for the Occupational Health bet: translate the Founder/GM's commercial thesis and market insight into product requirements, sequencing, and a roadmap that gets us to paying customers fast, and keep reshaping it as we learn.
Redefine the workflow, don't digitize the paperwork: question every legacy step, the manual exam booking, the paper ASO, the compliance theater, and rebuild it around the member, the company, and AI. A faster PDF is not the answer.
Make AI the core mechanic, not a feature: work with engineering to embed AI into scheduling, triage, compliance reporting, and the back office, so a lean squad can do what an incumbent's much larger operation does today.
Build for regulated ground truth: work hand in hand with legal, compliance, and SST domain experts to make sure the product is correct on NR-01, eSocial, and psychosocial-risk requirements before it is fast or delightful. In this market, compliance failures are not a bug, they are existential.
Drive planning and measurement: set OKRs, goals, and success metrics for the bet jointly with the Founder/GM, and report progress in a way that is honest about what's working and what isn't.
Work close to the customer: get in front of HR and SST buyers, clinics, and brokers yourself, alongside the commercial team, so product decisions are grounded in what you've heard directly, not what's been relayed to you.
Lead design and engineering execution: run backlog, rituals, and delivery with your design and engineering craft leads, keeping a small team focused and shipping weekly, not planning for a quarter.
Bring judgment in ambiguity: make calls with incomplete information, defend the ones that matter, and change your mind fast when the evidence says to.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

6+ years of product management experience, including time spent building a product from zero to one.
Experience in, or close proximity to, a highly regulated or compliance-heavy market (health, insurance, benefits, HR tech, occupational safety, or similar), and comfort making product calls where "move fast" has real limits.
Genuinely AI-native: you reach for AI as the default way to do more with less, direct agents to compress manual work, and are comfortable being a beginner on things AI changes every month.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills: able to use data and metrics to generate insight, prioritize ruthlessly, and know what to measure when the business itself is still being defined.
Entrepreneurial and self-driven, with a bias to ship and sell as the way to learn, balanced with the judgment to know which corners cannot be cut.
Comfortable operating without a playbook: this bet doesn't have an established product organization or years of process behind it; you'll help build both as you go.
Advanced English required; you'll work daily with stakeholders across BR, US, and EU.

Prototype rapidly.

Job Description
At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first
Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.
Drive an experimentation culture: form hypotheses, run A/B tests, read the results honestly, and iterate.
Operating as an AI-native Product Manager
Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and AI prototyping tools daily to accelerate discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.
Move quickly from research and discovery to validation, launch, and iteration using AI-assisted workflows.
Collaborating across teams
Work closely with Customer Success, Patient Marketing, Engineering, Data, Design, and country teams to deliver impact across markets.
Use qualitative and quantitative research to inform decisions and optimise customer outcomes.
Help evolve our marketplace and AI-native product practices and level up the wider product organisation.
What will set you up for success in this role?
Core Product Management experience
5+ years of Product Managemen t experience building digital consumer or marketplace products .
Strong product thinking and a user-centric mindset, paired with the commercial instinct to connect product decisions to business outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across both commercial and technical audiences.
Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Data teams.
Extreme ownership, comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping products in emerging spaces.
Exceptionally data-driven
Fluent with SQL and comfortable querying large datasets to explore, size, and validate opportunities independently.
Proven ability to translate business logic into ranking, scoring, or matching logic – and to reason clearly about the trade-offs.
Strong analytical and experimentation skills; you make decisions from data and can defend them.
Deep understanding of customer economics
Strong grasp of the metrics that drive a subscription marketplace: churn, retention, engagement, activation, ARPU, and lifetime value.
Experience owning or moving retention and engagement metrics for a customer base, not just shipping features.
