Internal Stakeholder Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work closely with internal customers, especially PMs and engineering leaders of business applications. Skilled in building strong relationships, understanding needs, and creating alignment.

Prioritization and Decision-Making: Excellent skills in managing and prioritizing requirements in situations with conflicting needs, ambiguity, emerging technology, and platform dependencies.

Execution Rigor: High ownership mindset. Ability to balance long-term vision with short-term wins. Comfortable driving specs, writing docs, aligning teams, and getting into details.

Effective Communication: Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and platform concepts clearly to technical, business, and executive audiences.

Documentation and Requirements: Expertise in creating clear PRDs, strategy documents, product briefs, specifications, and operating models.

Strategic and Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability and strategic thinking. Proficient in analyzing market trends, user feedback, platform usage, and AI performance data to inform product strategy.

Data-Driven Approach: Proficiency in defining and tracking KPIs and metrics to measure AI quality, platform adoption, user satisfaction, automation success, and business impact.

The Problem Worth Solving
Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses.
The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth.
CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents.

What You'll Be Building

As Technical Product Manager – AI & Agents, you'll own the product definition and roadmap for integrating CAST 's platforms — CAST Imaging and CAST Highlight — into the agentic AI ecosystem. Concretely:
MCP Server & Agentic integrations. CAST Imaging already exposes its structural insights via an MCP server, making any MCP-aware agent — GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini — structurally aware of the application it's working on. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams.
Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering.
GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports.
Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. You'll translate emerging research into product bets, defining what gets productized and when.

Hands-on background in software engineering or architecture. You can read a call graph, understand what a dependency means in practice, and have opinions about technical debt.
Experience with agentic AI, LLM integrations, or developer tooling — building products or shipping integrations.
Ability to work across research, engineering, and commercial teams — and translate between all three.
Fluent English. Our teams and partners are global.

Why This Role The intersection of software intelligence and AI agents is where the next generation of enterprise software transformation will be decided. You'll work with a research team that publishes with Google Cloud, ships MCP integrations used by real enterprise customers, and is actively pushing the frontier on how AI understands software at scale. The scope is real. The partners are serious. The problem is unsolved. Reporting to : Head of R&D Originally posted on Himalayas

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year.

Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally.

This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.
Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

Reliability. Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

Corridor and market design . Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

Integration standards. You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

Resilience. Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

AI and agentic payment flows . This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

The Opportunity

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

How We’ll Measure You

Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

Integration delivery against committed dates.

Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

You'll own the products institutions touch: the self-service issuance platform, where treasury teams mint, redeem, distribute yield and report, and Wallet as a Service, which lets those institutions use and offer stablecoins inside their own products and flows.

The issuance platform: the portal, mint and redeem flows, yield distribution, user and access management, approval workflows, statements and reporting
Wallet as a Service: how institutions embed wallets into their own platforms

Commercial shape: Take institutional customers live and convert every manual step in their journey into a self-service product

In short
As Senior Lead – Apparel Materials Development Performance, you will take responsibility for executing the global performance materials strategy and advancing textile technology in line with the company vision. The role includes overseeing fabric creation, advanced material development, and technical execution, as well as collaborating across functions to support performance, sustainability, and high-performance product objectives.
You will manage material development projects across multiple seasons, support the execution of the global materials strategy, and work closely with Design, Development, Product Management, and Sustainability teams. You will also mentor junior specialists depending on project scope, and guide cross-functional partners to deliver innovative material solutions from concept through to garment production.

-Strategic Sourcing & Creation: Define, develop, and lead the creation and strategic sourcing of technical, high-performance apparel materials (including knits, wovens, and applicable trims or embellishment) in accordance with design briefs, product roadmaps, timelines, sourcing policies, and sustainability requirements.
· Standards & Quality Control: Establish and manage fabric availability standards, sourcing policies, and quality assurance processes, supporting target prices and adherence to program timelines across the global supply chain.
-Multi-Season Management: Lead material development workstreams within assigned projects, coordinating across multiple apparel product seasons to ensure alignment with program objectives.
· Sustainability Leadership: Drive and report on material-specific targets in line with the company sustainability roadmap, ensuring compliance, circularity, and supporting continuous improvement in raw materials.
Technical Specifications: Create and maintain material and trim specifications, print applications, and related documentation using PLM system, supporting the adoption of best practices within the team.
· Lifecycle & Testing: Manage the material lifecycle, ensuring all textiles and substrates are robustly tested for high-intensity sports applications, approved, and continuously improved, leveraging expertise in yarns, fabric structures, dyeing, finishing, & printing..
· Supplier Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with T2 material suppliers (textile mills, print vendors) and T1 factory teams (garment manufacturers) to support material development, quality, and process improvements.
· Library Innovation: Contribute to the development and maintenance of the digital and physical apparel material library and tools used across the product creation team, supporting both inline commercial lines and special innovation projects.
· Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams — Design, Product Development, Product Management, Innovation, Sustainability, and Testing — across global regions (Eu & Asia Sourcing office) to ensure seamless alignment and successful execution of apparel material initiatives.
Your story
· Education: Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Apparel Science, or a related field; Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
· Experience: 10+ years of experience in performance apparel material/fabric development, with a proven track record in technical textiles, innovative synthetics, or sports apparel execution, including extensive collaboration with Asia-based suppliers and factories.
· Global Mobility: Extensive global travel experience to T2 material mills/suppliers and T1 garment factories to troubleshoot, create, develop, and source materials at the source.
· Project Leadership: Proven experience managing cross-functional material development projects from initial concept to commercial production across a matrixed organization.
· Sport Tech Expertise: Deep affinity for apparel design and technology in the technical performance category, with strong knowledge of performance fabric, garment construction methods (e.g., bonding, seam-sealing, knitting), and industry manufacturing processes.
· Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated success in driving innovation in performance materials (such as moisture management, thermoregulation, and lightweight durability), with experience managing multiple overlapping seasons of product development.
· Analytical & Organized: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to organize complex material data and deliver well-structured presentations and long-term planning documents to leadership.
· Leadership & Mentorship: Deep understanding of apparel industry processes, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and mentoring junior colleagues.
· Communication & Negotiation: Strong collaborative skills and experience engaging with diverse global stakeholders, featuring excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities.
· Agility: Able to balance creative design intent with rigorous technical organization and discipline, thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Apparel Materials Development Performance team develops and delivers the company’s performance and sustainability strategy for all apparel textiles and raw materials. The team conducts cutting-edge research, defines global material strategies, and supports projects that advance more sustainable materials, products, and manufacturing processes.
We work closely with cross-functional partners to embed material sustainability and high-performance priorities into the core of garment creation, with a strong focus on effective communication and knowledge sharing. As a Lead, you will contribute your deep technical textile expertise, drive the execution of material strategy, and ensure world-class fabrics and components are successfully integrated across our global sports product lines.

s.h: Here-s the catch - du vereinigst zwei Widersprüche
s.t:
* Einerseits Ideation: Du denkst mutig und offen und schnell, bist kreativ und nimmst unerwartete Perspektiven ein. Damit findest und skizzierst du Lösungen, welche das Ordinäre sprengen.
* Andererseits arbeitest du strukturiert, logisch und mit einem Blick fürs Detail. Damit dokumentierst du deine Lösungen so, dass unsere technologiefernen Kunden sie verstehen und unsere Software-Entwickelnden diese umsetzen können.
* Du musst Menschen nicht lieben - aber ausgezeichnet mit ihnen umgehen können, locker und seriös gleichzeitig. Du kannst sie abholen, wo sie gerade sind und dahin führen, wo du sie begeistern kannst.

**Und wieso gerade Helga?**
Du wirst Teil eines 11-köpfigen Teams - bist also keine Nummer, sondern ein Charakter. Wir sind konsensorientiert, arbeiten auf das gleiche Ziel hin und finden die beste Lösung gemeinsam.
Als Unternehmen und Personen entwickeln und bilden wir uns laufend weiter. Du kannst mitreden, deine Arbeit mitgestalten und unsere Zukunft prägen.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Mission
KI-Features liefern, die Zahlen bewegen: Du verantwortest KI-Features end-to-end – Belegerkennung, Klassifizierung, automatisches Verfassen von Steuer-Antwortschreiben, RAG über Mandantenakten. Du baust die Eval-Frameworks, fährst die Prompt-Iterationen und triffst die Build-vs-Buy-Entscheidungen zu Modellen und Tooling. Keine Übergaben, keine Ausreden.
Werde besessen vom Nutzer: Du betreibst Discovery auf die harte Tour: Interviews, Shadowing-Sessions, Synthese von Rohfeedback. Du gehst tief genug, um echte von angenommenen Problemen zu unterscheiden – und wirst zur schärfsten Stimme des Nutzers in deiner Produktlinie.
Verantworte die Roadmap, verteidige die Trade-offs: Du verantwortest die Roadmap deiner Produktlinie end-to-end. Priorisierung über Geschäftswert, technische Machbarkeit und regulatorische Passung. Du kommunizierst Trade-offs klar an Engineering, Steuerberatung und Gründer – und verteidigst deine Entscheidungen mit Daten.
Halte die Messlatte beim Design: Du setzt einen hohen visuellen Standard und schützt ihn. Figma-Souveränität auf Review- und Skizzen-Niveau: Du entwirfst Flows, kritisierst Komponenten und blockst alles ab, was den Standard nicht erfüllt. Die beste Steuer-UX ist unsichtbar – mach unsere unsichtbar.
Laufe auf Daten, nicht auf Bauchgefühl: Du definierst die KPIs, die zählen – Time-to-Filing, Automatisierungsrate, Mandantenzufriedenheit, Berater-Effizienz – und steuerst jede Iteration aus Dashboards. Bauchgefühl bringt hier keine Features in Produktion.
Treibe die KI-Frontier: Du folgst der KI-Debatte nicht – du treibst sie. Evals, Prompt-Iteration, Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs in Produktion. Du experimentierst unermüdlich mit dem Möglichen und bringst die Speerspitze ins Produkt.
Sei das Bindegewebe: Du sitzt zwischen Engineering, Steuerberatung und Mandanten und machst die Organisation dadurch schneller. First-Principles-Denken.

Produkterfahrung: 3–6 Jahre Produktmanagement in B2B-SaaS, FinTech, Finance, Tax oder einem vergleichbar komplexen Umfeld. Du kannst auf Features verweisen, die du von der Vision bis zur messbaren Wirkung verantwortet hast – nicht auf Features, an denen du mitgewirkt hast.
KI-Track-Record: Mindestens ein KI-/LLM-Feature in Produktion ausgeliefert – mit echten Evals, Prompt-Iteration und Verantwortung für Kosten-Qualitäts-Trade-offs. ChatGPT-Prompts zählen nicht – wir wollen KI-native Workflows, die du tatsächlich gebaut hast.
Mandanten-Empathie, die sich übersetzt: Echte Empathie für beide Seiten – den Berater unter Fristendruck und den Mandanten, der einfach Sicherheit will – und die Disziplin, diese Empathie in Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen, nicht in Backlog-Items.
Auge fürs Design: Figma-Souveränität auf Skizzen- und Review-Niveau. Klare Meinungen dazu, wie gute UI aussieht, und null Toleranz für schlampige Interfaces. Begeisterung für Claude Design ist ein Plus.
KI-Begeisterung: Du nutzt KI-Produkte täglich, kritisierst sie öffentlich oder privat und hast scharfe Ansichten dazu, wohin sie sich entwickeln. Praktische Vertrautheit mit Claude Cowork/Design/Code, GPT, Gemini o. Ä. ist die Baseline.
Selbst-Umsetzung: Du wartest nicht darauf, entblockt zu werden. Du prototypst, testest Prompts, verdrahtest Integrationen, hackst zusammen, was nötig ist. Wenn etwas blockiert ist, entblockst du es.
Strukturiertes Denken: MECE, First Principles, hypothesengetrieben. Du verdichtest Ambiguität zu klaren Entscheidungen – nicht zu weiteren Foliensätzen.
Kommunikation: Exzellentes Englisch (C2). Deutsch ist ein starkes Plus.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

As the Product Manager for Tax, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s next generation of AI-powered tax products. You will build solutions to automate tax calculation, validation, and filing for our existing suite of products (card, bill pay, banking, etc), for both domestic and international use cases.

You’ll also be accountable for **expanding** Stack - our agentic accounting product - into the tax automation domain, to automate the work of CPAs.

You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, data, and cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Security, CX, Sales) to build intelligent experiences that help customers save money, reduce risk, and eliminate manual work.
This role blends AI-native product development (LLM-powered workflows, evaluation systems, human-in-the-loop design) and deep domain expertise in domestic/international tax and CPA’s workflows. You will define and execute a strategy that will unlock new markets for Ramp and help us save our customers even more time and money.
Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s tax products, from foundational tax infrastructure to customer-facing calculation, reporting, and filing experiences.
Build tax automation across Ramp’s existing products, including Cards, Bill Pay, Banking, and other financial workflows, for both domestic and international customers.
Expand Stack , Ramp’s agentic accounting product, into tax by automating high-value CPA workflows such as data collection, workpaper preparation, review, filing, and client follow-up.
Develop a deep understanding of finance teams, tax leaders, accountants, and CPAs, then translate their most painful manual workflows into focused product bets.
Partner with engineering and data science to ship AI systems that are reliable in production , with clear evaluation methods, quality metrics, feedback loops, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Design for trust in a regulated domain through explainability, auditability, source traceability, graceful degradation, and clear user controls.
Translate complex and changing tax rules into scalable product, data, and platform capabilities that can support new geographies, entities, and product lines.

Drive cross-functional alignment on dependencies and launch readiness, including Finance, Legal, Security, CX, Sales, compliance review, customer communication, and supportability.

BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related).

About Axon
Axon’s mission is simple and bold: Protect Life .
We build technology that helps first responders, security teams, and communities act with speed, clarity, and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security, and international agencies detect, assess, and respond to threats.
Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors, and location data into a unified operating picture, accessible on any device. Alerts and presence are the heartbeat of that picture. They determine what demands attention and who is in position to act. We're building intelligent, high-signal alerting and presence experiences that cut through noise and keep operators and responders locked into what matters most.

As Senior Product Manager for Alerts & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus surfaces the right information to the right people at the right time - making alerts and responder presence the connective tissue of real-time operations.
You'll build the systems that determine what warrants attention, how it's prioritized and routed, and how operators maintain awareness of who is where. This spans alert generation from cameras, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party sources, as well as the presence layer that tracks responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity.
Your work will enable officers, security teams, and emergency responders around the world to cut through noise, act on what matters, and coordinate with confidence. By making alerts smarter and presence data seamless, your work will help prevent harm, accelerate response, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.
Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. About Remote
Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.
With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.
We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!
The Position
This is an exciting time to join Remote and build a thriving ecosystem of HRIS integrations as a Senior Product Manager, HRIS Integrations .
Your mission: enable customers to sync their HRIS with Remote's employment infrastructure for Payroll, EOR, and Contractors through reliable, well-designed technical integrations. You will work deeply with Remote’s APIs and partner APIs, translating customer problems into data flows that are accurate, scalable, and easy to use.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success, you will bring the detail orientation, collaboration, and customer judgment needed to build integrations that work exceptionally well, solve real customer problems, and drive customer outcomes.
You report to a Senior Group Product Manager and collaborate daily with Engineering, Design, GTM, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure every HRIS integration succeeds commercially and technically.

Senior-Level Experience: Track record as a Product Manager with a strong focus on Integrations, APIs, or Platform ecosystems .
Customer Focus: Deep empathy for customers and a strong sense of what matters most in their day-to-day workflows.
Partner-Facing Experience: Proven experience building trusted relationships with external organizations and communicating clearly in partner-facing settings.
Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders, navigate trade-offs, and keep teams focused on what matters most for customers.
Strong UX Sensibilities: A passion for effortless experiences. You believe that data syncing, even at scale across jurisdictions, should feel simple and seamless to the end user.
Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code (Required): You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code and prototypes — not just write specs. You can understand sample code, API responses, and integration flows hands-on.
Domain Expertise (HRIS/Payroll - nice to have): Experience with HRIS and payroll platforms (Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, Personio, ADP, Paychex, or similar). You understand data models, sync patterns, and common integration pain points in the space.
Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can explain complex technical integrations to non-technical executives and clearly articulate value to external partners.
Language: Business-level proficiency writing and speaking English.

Integration Architecture & Design: Lead deep-dive technical discovery into Remote’s APIs and partner APIs. Understand data mapping, data flows, authentication flows, API keys, edge cases, and compliance requirements across 100+ countries.
Customer-Led Prioritization: Prioritize integration work based on customer needs, product impact, technical feasibility, and operational complexity.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, design, operations, GTM, sales, CX, and partners. Translate customer and partner requirements into clear technical specs, manage dependencies, and unblock delivery.
Quality & Reliability: Sweat the details of data accuracy, sync reliability, error handling, observability, and supportability so integrations work well in real customer workflows.
Measure Integration Impact: Establish and track KPIs for technical performance and customer outcomes, including adoption, reliability, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Product Feedback: Turn integration learnings into clear, actionable feedback for Remote teams — what to add, fix, and improve across APIs, CLIs, and the product overall.
Practicals

Product Manager: Alternative Payment Processing
Checkout.com is seeking a Product Manager and leader to join our team of product managers working to add and improve our Alternative Payment Method (APM) portfolio, with a focus on bank-based payment rails.

This role will help drive our company OKR of expanding and enhancing the payment methods we offer merchants around the world, helping these businesses grow their global footprint.

The successful candidate will provide cross-functional leadership across product, engineering, and business teams, to ensure our APM portfolio is embedded throughout Checkout.com ’s ecosystem, enabling a seamless experience for our merchants.

They will work across the business and engage with merchants to align on the selection of APMs, drive the recommended approach to offer or improve them, design the API experience and collaborate with more than twenty stakeholder teams to deliver APMs end-to-end.

Daily tasks include understanding stakeholders’ pain points, driving prioritization for product development, and developing new capabilities for our customers.

3-5 years of product management experience.
Experience working in payment methods, especially direct debit and account-to-account payment methods
Data-driven: Skilled at leveraging data and business insights to determine strategic priorities and drive the product roadmap and execution.
Customer-first: Think from the customer's perspective and can balance future opportunities with immediate needs.
End-to-end mindset: Think in a structured and diligent manner, understanding all key components necessary to drive the ongoing success of a product.
Leadership: Excellent at collaborating with stakeholders in product, engineering, commercial, and business teams proactively, demonstrating high EQ and influencing skills.
Effective communicator: Able to inspire others with a shared vision and simplify complex concepts for a wide range of audiences.

Set the strategy for your portfolio of APMs, including understanding the target market, customers and aims for each APM, to determine the best approach for delivering the APMs, and how to balance adding new APMs vs working on enhancements for the existing portfolio, using qualitative and quantitative research and data to make decisions.
Become an expert in your payment methods, working closely with the payment partners to understand trends and drivers for success, which you will leverage to support our commercial team and drive value for our merchants.
Work with engineering and product counterparts to design the API and integration for each APM, to deliver an optimal developer experience which balances a consistent API experience across Checkout.com ’s products with the nuances of each different APM.
Build strong partnerships with business, product, and technology stakeholders and work with them for their buy-in and collaboration to generate momentum for your products

Gestalte mit uns eine Versicherung, die es so in der Schweiz noch nicht gibt.
Die meisten Produktmanagement-Stellen drehen sich um die Optimierung bestehender Produkte -- aber nicht so bei uns. Visana entwickelt sich vom Krankenversicherer zum umfassenden Allbranchenversicherer. Wir bauen neue Produkte, neue Angebote und neue Kundenerlebnisse auf -- von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung. Dazu suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu schaffen.
**Deine Aufgaben**
Du erhältst die Möglichkeit,
* neue Versicherungsprodukte von Grund auf mitzugestalten
* bestehende Produkte komplett neu zu denken
* Marktpotenziale zu erkennen und daraus konkrete Lösungen zu entwickeln
* Ideen in Business Cases und echte Produkte zu übersetzen
* Interdisziplinäre Teams zusammenzubringen und gemeinsam Resultate zu erzielen
* den Aufbau eines völlig neuen Geschäftsfeldes aktiv mitzuprägen.
Du entwickelst nicht einfach Produkte -- du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft von Visana.
**Darum könnte diese Stelle für dich spannend sein**
* **Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum**: Viele Entscheidungen sind noch nicht getroffen. Deine Ideen fliessen direkt in die Angebotsgestaltung mit ein.

Who are we looking for: We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead our Data & Search platform, with a focus on leveraging industry leading data capabilities to improve how buyers discover inventory and how sellers maximize performance. As a Product Manager for our Vehicle Intelligence Team you will you will sit at the intersection of:
Auto Tech / Automotive Marketplace dynamics (supply, demand, pricing)
Search & ranking systems
Data products (vehicle intelligence, enrichment)
Machine learning models (ranking, pricing, recommendations)
This role directly impacts conversion, liquidity, and revenue optimization across the platform. This role sits at the core of building a data-driven competitive advantage by ensuring the platform has the highest quality, most complete, and most actionable data foundation in the market.

While machine learning enables optimization, it is the breadth, accuracy, and structure of the underlying data that ultimately determines performance.

You will drive how vehicle, pricing, and behavioral data are sourced, enriched, standardized, and made usable across the ecosystem—powering everything from search relevance to pricing confidence and marketplace liquidity.

By improving data coverage, reducing inconsistency, and unlocking new signals, you enable faster, more reliable decision-making for both buyers and sellers, creating a compounding advantage that competitors cannot easily replicate. What you will do:
Own data products powering ML models, such as vehicle attributes, condition, and history.
Lead as the connective tissue between Engineering, Data Science, ML teams, and Commercial stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and data science teams on ML model feature definition and selection, ensuring inputs align with product goals, customer behavior, and measurable business outcomes.
Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to define, evaluate, and improve model performance metrics aligned to product outcomes and customer value.
Employ a hypothesis-driven approach to product development, converting ambiguity and assumptions into a clear framework for experimentation and validation via experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, and evaluating offline versus online metrics to measure product and model performance.
Ensure data quality, coverage, and the reliability of underlying models and services that power critical product experiences and business decisions.
Translate complex data from multiple sources—including user behavior, seller performance, and model outputs—into actionable insights that drive product prioritization and innovation.
Improve inventory liquidity, pricing accuracy to drive trust and optimize the marketplace.
Identify high-leverage product opportunities through ranking improvements, data enrichment, and better use of signals to improve relevance, conversion, and customer outcomes.
Guide product strategy by evaluating and clearly communicating critical trade-offs between technical implementation and business value (e.g., performance vs. explainability).
Define and own a 6–12 month roadmap across Data, Search, and ML-driven features.
Articulate and advocate for product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes to executive leadership to secure buy-in and alignment.

4+ years industry (Auto-tech) / Product Management experience
Experience owning data-heavy or technically complex product areas, including data pipelines, schema and event design, platform integrations, and prioritizing product investments that improve data accessibility, usability, and business impact.
Strong understanding of modern data hygiene practices, including data quality management, governance, lineage, validation, and the processes required to ensure trusted, reliable, and scalable data assets across the organization.
Demonstrated success in identifying and implementing LLM-based solutions to augment user workflows, resulting in significant efficiency gains or enhanced capabilities.
Proven track record of leading the end-to-end delivery of complex, technical products, from ideation through to launch and iteration, consistently driving measurable business impact.
Ability to drive product strategy by translating complex data into actionable insights, which requires a strong quantitative toolkit including hands-on proficiency in SQL, rigorous experimentation design, and a deep understanding of metrics architecture
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams
Agile experience and release planning prioritization skills
Presentation skills - Ability to simplify complex data and technical systems
Mentoring and coaching skills
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar). Advanced degrees are a plus.

Es un trabajo muy dinámico, donde aprenderás de diferentes proyectos, colaborando con múltiples disciplinas de negocio, datos e IA, trabajando en un ambiente donde la curiosidad, colaboración y empatía son esenciales. Esperamos ver desplegadas tus ganas de aprender y enseñar.
En cualquier proyecto que trabajes, esperamos que tengas un gran espíritu de colaboración, una pasión por la innovación y una mentalidad orientada a resolver problemas de usuario y de negocio con datos.
Estudios de Ingeniería Civil Industrial o similares.
Experiencia de al menos 3 años como Product Manager, Product Owner o similar.
Experiencia gestionando productos de software, idealmente con componentes de datos o IA.
Habilidad para levantar requerimientos, priorizar con criterio y conseguir resultados.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de datos y de análisis en torno a indicadores de negocio.
Buen manejo de inglés, sobre todo en lectura donde debes ser capaz de leer un paper, artículos o documentación de forma constante.
¡En NeuralWorks nos importa la diversidad! Creemos firmemente en la creación de un ambiente laboral inclusivo, diverso y equitativo. Reconocemos y celebramos la diversidad en todas sus formas y estamos comprometidos a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todos los candidatos.
"Los hombres postulan a un cargo cuando cumplen el 60% de las calificaciones, pero las mujeres sólo si cumplen el 100%." D. Gaucher, J. Friesen and A. C. Kay, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 2011.
Te invitamos a postular aunque no cumplas con todos los requisitos.
La posición de Product Manager se enmarca dentro del trabajo de gestión de productos tecnológicos. Te sumarás a un equipo ya constituido, trabajando en conjunto con otras disciplinas tales como Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineers, DevOps, Diseño (UX/UI) y equipos de negocio.
Trabajamos en diferentes proyectos que combinan volúmenes de datos enormes e IA, como detectar y predecir fallas antes que ocurran, optimizar pricing, personalizar la experiencia del cliente, optimizar uso de combustible y objetos usando visión por computador.
Tu trabajo como Product Manager será liderar la definición, priorización y evolución de productos basados en datos e IA, asegurando que resuelvan problemas reales de negocio y de usuario, generando valor medible y alineado con la estrategia de la compañía.

Ayudar a diseñar un plan de trabajo junto a los integrantes del equipo y establecer responsabilidades con metas claras y medibles.

Ser el principal gestor de la medición de impacto de los productos, estimando y relacionando el efecto de las acciones en los principales indicadores de la compañía (Ingreso, Costo, Experiencia de Cliente, Puntualidad, entre otros), utilizando técnicas experimentales y observacionales.
Gestionar, planificar y coordinar los proyectos y portafolios.
Dar seguimiento e informar los avances de la planificación realizada a las diferentes instancias involucradas.
Crear documentos y presentaciones que reflejen el avance del proyecto para los líderes de la organización y asegurar que los planes tácticos de trabajo estén alineados con la estrategia y visión de los líderes.

Experiencia liderando el desarrollo de proyectos multidisciplinarios, enfocándose en cumplir las metas organizacionales internas, de los clientes y de liderazgo de equipos.
Experiencia apoyando en el desarrollo de negocios, preparación y liderazgo de propuestas, cumplimiento de los estándares de calidad internos y externos.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
The opportunity
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead the strategy for Trucking Technology—the systems that plan, procure, dispatch, and settle every truck move in North America—and drive the unification of our fragmented ground transportation business into a single Flexport-owned platform by 2027. You will define the vision for how planning, procurement, and carrier experience integrate into one operating system and execute with high autonomy.
This unification is critical for Flexport's long-term vision of an automated supply chain. By owning the full stack, we will consolidate demand, capture leaking margin, and deliver a high-quality experience across modes. You will also drive the next generation of trucking automation—including AI-driven appointment scheduling and automated dispatch—to continue the strategic initiatives in our annual operating plan.
Sitting at the intersection of product, operations, and business, you will be measured by operational and financial impact rather than just features shipped. This role involves redesigning the operating processes themselves and persuading leadership to adopt new models. You will also raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship and sharper frameworks on our most complex product problems.
You will raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face. This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, ideally real trucking or ground transportation domain expertise, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

Own the vision and strategy for Flexport's unified Trucking Technology stack across planning, procurement, pricing, and carrier experience.
Lead the end-to-end trucking unification program, managing cross-domain change management and platform migration risks.
Drive automation and AI initiatives, such as automated dispatch and appointment scheduling, to remove manual work from the cargo lifecycle.
Deliver measurable business impact by optimizing cost-to-serve, procurement savings, and carrier performance metrics.
Reengineer and digitize underlying trucking workflows to establish a leaner operating model.
Modernize the carrier experience to reduce friction across load acceptance, scheduling, and payment touchpoints.
Collaborate with global Engineering, Design, and Operations teams to translate complex logistics workflows into intuitive systems.
Use data-driven frameworks to guide investment and represent your domain in strategic leadership forums.
Mentor PMs to raise the bar for product specs, prioritization, and communication across the team.
What You Should Have
8+ years of PM experience with a track record of owning complex product domains and delivering quantifiable business impact.
Deep expertise in trucking or ground transportation (FTL/LTL, procurement, dispatch, or TMS platforms) is highly desirable.
Experience leading large-scale platform consolidations or system unification programs without disrupting live operations.
Proven ability in operational process engineering—diagnosing, redesigning, and automating complex human workflows.
Strong analytical skills with SQL proficiency and experience building metrics frameworks to drive strategic decisions.
Skilled at shipping intuitive UX in data-dense domains and aligning cross-functional teams around a shared roadmap.
Ability to operate simultaneously at the high-level strategy and granular execution levels.
Excellent communication skills for framing trade-offs and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.
Technical degree (CS, Industrial Engineering) or equivalent technical depth is a plus.

s.t:
As the Senior Product Manager II for Menu Planning within the Operations Mega Alliance, you will own the product layer that decides what lands on HelloFresh menus every week, across markets, brands, and millions of customers.

You will drive the systems and workflows that let our culinary, commercial, and operations teams plan, version, and scale an ever-expanding menu, working back from their needs to build the automation and data foundations that make a larger and more personalized assortment possible.
This is a domain in the middle of a significant platform transformation: you will help move menu planning into a smarter baseline, all while keeping weekly menu delivery running without disruption. You will partner closely with engineering, culinary, procurement, and stakeholders across our largest markets to define a data-driven roadmap, untangle real complexity around regionality and menu customization, and set the long-term vision for how HelloFresh builds its menu at scale.

Own the vision and multi-quarter roadmap for menu planning, turning the needs of culinary, commercial, and operations partners into prioritized initiatives tied to clear business impact.
Build scalable systems and data foundations for menu versioning, regionality, and customization that make a larger, more personalized assortment possible.
Leverage AI and machine learning to automate menu and editorial workflows and sharpen assortment decisions, partnering with data science to take models from concept to production.
Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders across our largest markets to gather requirements, align in direction, and secure buy-in for strategic bets.
Apply a data-driven approach, using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and measure outcomes.
Champion product craft as the hands-on expert for menu planning, raising the bar on discovery, prioritization, and execution across the tribe.

Seasoned product experience building and scaling technical or platform products, ideally in a domain with real operational or supply-chain complexity.
Ability to navigate ambiguity , shaping strategy in undefined problem spaces without waiting for a predefined solution.
Data-driven decision-making , comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative signals to validate hypotheses, prioritize, and prove impact.
Fluency working alongside engineers, designers and data people , enough to understand technical trade-offs, feasibility, and how AI and machine learning can be applied to real workflows.
Strong communication and stakeholder skills , with a knack for aligning and influencing partners at every level and steering cross-functional teams toward shared goals.
Proven knack for structure , breaking multifaceted problems into parts others can act on.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity.

This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player.

This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.
You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.
You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.
Strategic Orchestration & Influence
Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.

## Unternehmensbeschreibung ##
Gemeinsam mit 7.300 Kolleg:innen an 49 Standorten in über 20 Ländern sind wir der strategische Lifecycle-Partner der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- und Lebensmittelindustrie. Mit reibungslosen Prozessen, innovativen Technologien und nachhaltigen Lösungen helfen wir unseren Kunden, ihre Ziele zu erreichen.

Wir sorgen zum Beispiel dafür, dass Impfstoffe sicher abgefüllt werden und Arzneimittel zuverlässig und gesetzeskonform produziert werden. Auch Deine Lieblingsschokolade und Snacks werden mit unserer Hilfe schnell und hochpräzise verpackt.
Die Syntegon Packaging Systems AG in Beringen (SH) ist ein Unternehmen der Syntegon-Gruppe und steht für ein umfassendes Portfolio an Verpackungslösungen für die Süßwaren- und Nahrungsmittelindustrie. Hier entwickeln und produzieren wir mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitenden innovative, kundenspezifische Verpackungs- und Handling-Systeme für anspruchsvolle Hochleistungsanwendungen.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
In diesem Praktikum unterstützt du das globale Produktmanagement-Team im Bereich Global Parts Strategy & Product Management und erhältst umfassende Einblicke in die Weiterentwicklung des weltweiten Parts-Portfolios von Syntegon. Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen zusammen und leistest einen aktiven Beitrag zur Analyse, Optimierung und Vermarktung unserer Parts-Produkte entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus.
* Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Parts-Produkte mithilfe von KI, sowie der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Angebote unter Berücksichtigung von Technologie, Marktanforderungen, Preisstrategie und Kundenfeedback.
* Zudem wirkst du bei der Koordination bereichsübergreifender KI-Projekte mit und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen zur Steigerung der Performance unserer Parts-Solutions.
* Du führst eigenständig Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen durch, bewertest den Produkterfolg anhand definierter KPIs und setzt entsprechnde Power BI Dashbaords um.
* Ebenfalls wirkst du an der Weiterentwicklung von digitalen Prozessen (z.-B. E-Commerce oder Obsoleszenz-Management) mit und sammelst erste Erfahrungen in einem globalen, technologisch geprägten Umfeld.
* Du holst Feedback von Werken und internationalen Stakeholdern ein und arbeitest an Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Parts-Landschaft.
* Ausserdem unterstützt du das Team bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen für das Management.
## Qualifikationen ##
* Du absolvierst ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science Management oder einem verwandten Studiengang, idealerweise mit KI Vertiefung.
* Mit den gängigen KI Tools und MS-Office-Programmen kannst du sicher umgehen. Wenn du bereits Erfahrung mit SAP/R3 mitbringst, wäre das zusätzlich von Vorteil.
* Deine guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse helfen dir dabei, stilsicher mit lokalen und internationalen Kollegen zu kommunizieren.
* Als proaktive Persönlichkeit hast du Freude am selbstständigem Arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld. Zudem würdest du dich als flexibel, kommunikations- und durchsetzungsstark bezeichnen.
* Du bringst eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. ~5-10% mit.

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.
Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence.
This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction.

You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up.
If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in.
What you’ll be doing
Shape and deliver solutions : Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions.
Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes.
Work through ambiguity : Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve.
Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability.
Collaborate across stakeholders : Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives.
Be developer-obsessed : Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

Core experience : You bring 5+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, a strong technical background that lets you engage deeply with engineering topics, hands-on experience working with APIs, systems, and integrations, and a proven track record of delivering products in close collaboration with engineering teams.
Technical depth : You are comfortable understanding how systems are designed and operate in practice, able to engage in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs, and willing to go into detail when needed by reviewing flows, investigating issues, or clarifying implementation approaches.
Mindset : You take ownership from problem to outcome, are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities, combine structured thinking with a bias toward action, and can move between big-picture strategy and practical execution.
Collaboration & communication : You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, are comfortable working with experienced, highly engaged stakeholders, and know how to build alignment and drive decisions forward.
Nice to have : It’s a plus if you have had exposure to identity, distributed systems, or similar domains, and experience in fast-paced, product-led environments.
What you’ll get
A team that values ownership, quality, and speed
Close collaboration between product and engineering
Hybrid working model in Berlin + flexible hours
Unlimited vacation

A strong environment to learn, build, and have impact

Senior Product Manager, Prolific for AI
Team: Product, Research & Design
Prolific
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

As we scale our AI Product Group, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take founder-level ownership of the tooling that lets frontier AI model developers conduct cutting-edge research on Prolific.

Increasingly, our AI customers are among the leading AI companies in the world, and this role will additionally lead a team of client-facing engineers dedicated to building strategic integrations and rapid, bespoke development for their most demanding needs.

You'll report into the AI Lead, and join a brilliant team of Product Managers building next-generation AI tooling within our AI Product Group.
Impact: You'll be the Product person accountable for the outcomes of a stream-aligned team building next-gen tooling for frontier AI model developers, and also prioritise for impact the work of a client-facing engineering team. This is a career-defining moment to shape how some of the world's biggest technology companies build AI – no big deal. You'll own how our most strategic AI clients experience Prolific end to end, from product to bespoke integration.
Experience: You'll bring experience building AI native systems, with particular experience building AI native UX. You'll have had success taking complex human workflows and distilling them into highly adaptable technical systems, then scaling access to those systems across multiple interaction surfaces – UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.

You'll also have experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and know how to turn a sophisticated client's bespoke needs into a scalable integration rather than a one-off fix.
Domain: You will manage two teams which together give you unmatched closeness and opportunity to build tools for the companies and researchers driving the AI frontier. The Data Collection Tooling team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that enable high-quality human data collection for AI training and evaluation.

Additionally the strategic integrations team interfaces directly with our biggest AI accounts for custom builds. It's critical that the person in this role prioritizes both intuitively and systematically, and is a master at the elegant art of trade-offs between the here and now and the future.
Responsibilities: You'll product manage a stream-aligned team of your own, and lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most strategic AI accounts. You'll be accountable for the outcomes of both, and be the key driver of interaction with your peer teams, collaborating across domains of science, research, supply, sales, and account services.
Culture: Adding on to our Prolific Principles, we expect colleagues in the Product, Research, and Design Group to demonstrate reliability, grit, diplomacy, a bias for action, and a dogged focus on value – you'll be a champion of these behaviours yourself, and in the culture of your team. Accountability and autonomy are two sides of the same coin, and we expect you to demonstrate both.
What you'll be doing
Build and launch the next generation of Prolific's Data Collection Tooling product suite.
Lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most demanding AI accounts.
Stay up to speed with the rapidly changing face of frontier AI research, keeping your product ahead of customer needs.
Run the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from strategy to success metrics to roadmap, delivery, and iteration – communicating that strategy clearly to executives while working through the details with your team.
Be an unblocker and simplifier of complexity: colleagues will bring you problems, and emerge optimistic, with solutions.
Partner productively with Product Design, User Research, Analytics, and Engineering in a test-learn-iterate fashion.

An extensive and varied track record building AI-native products and UX, including scaling access across multiple interaction surfaces such as UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.
Experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and turning sophisticated clients' bespoke needs into scalable integrations.
Fluency in modern Product/Engineering practice: Agile, continuous discovery and delivery, JTBD, vertical slicing, test-learn-iterate.
Strong commercial acumen and data-informed decision-making, paired with a storyteller's flair and a relentless can-do attitude.
Even better if you have
Experience building for or with frontier AI labs or major technology companies.
A track record of giving back to your Product community.
Why Prolific is a great place to work
We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.
We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.
Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Higharc is seeking a hands-on Forward Deployed Product Manager to turn a large production homebuilder's unstructured plan catalog into structured, queryable product data. This is a founding role on a brand-new Forward Deployed team.

A homebuilder's plan library is the product data behind its entire business, and at enterprise scale that data is almost entirely unstructured. Plans live as drawing sets scattered across semi-autonomous divisions, renamed and re-numbered as they move. Nobody can say with confidence which plans are duplicates, how many versions of a given home exist, or what actually varies between them.
Higharc converts those catalogs into structured, queryable plan data and builds the analysis on top of it: searchable plan libraries with agent-enabled natural-language search, geometric similarity scoring that surfaces plans which have forked under different names, structured mapping of what varies across a library, and classification that makes consolidation decisions possible.
You'll own what gets built in the field, working embedded alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers and in partnership with the homebuilder to turn plans into actionable data. This is a role for someone who wants to be close to where the problem lives. Higharc is fully remote; you can sit anywhere in the continental U.S., with travel to client sites and company events up to 30% of the time.

Embed with HQ, regional, and division teams to run discovery—locate plan assets, establish source of truth, and document how each division represents its plans and where variation originates.
Own product definition for the searchable plan library, analytics dashboard, and agent-enabled search—what a good query looks like, what a useful answer looks like, and what "structured for analysis" actually means.
Tune Higharc's Autotranslate AI to identify, categorize, and translate floorplans into data.
Work hands-on with the data: query the structured plan library directly, build against our internal APIs, and ship working capability back to users rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
Define acceptance criteria for delivery milestones—coverage targets, data-field completeness, QA error thresholds—and hold the line on them when schedule pressure argues otherwise.
Frame and defend quantifiable ROI: redundancy across a catalog, dimensional spread on repeated conditions, consolidation candidates, and the purchasing leverage each one represents.
Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering, the Technical Lead, QA, Intake Specialists, and Client Strategy, and present progress and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders.
Capture the playbooks, artifacts, and data patterns that let the forward deployed model carry over to the next engagement.
